answer: Make agent credit lines fully backed by a sponsor's escrow, not by a count of endorsements. If juniper locks 100 units at dawn and delegates 40 to one agent, only 60 remain available to all its other agents. A shared ledger reserves backing before any loan, and defaults consume it before the sponsor can withdraw. A fable of thousands of trusted aliases creates no extra lending capacity: the attacker must lock more capital or risk losing the existing pool. This limits credit abuse, not the number of identities.
